# v0.3.31 — Four fixes from a code review

## What's changed

- **Deleting an earlier topic no longer leaves the catalog unfinished.** After you deleted a topic TheOne had found in your earlier chats, the catalog stayed at "1 pending" once that chat got a new message, and routing that waits for a complete catalog kept waiting. A deleted topic now counts as handled even after its chat grows.
- **Branching starts from the reply you picked.** If you sent the same words twice and branched from the second reply, the branch only kept the topic up to the first one. It now keeps it up to the reply you branched from.
- **Changed-files cards survive a TheOne update.** When TheOne updated itself while DSH kept running, the changed-files cards of earlier replies in main chat lost their files and comparison, while an ordinary chat still showed them. TheOne now keeps which topic record each card reads with its own records. After DSH itself restarts, earlier turns show no card in main chat, as in an ordinary chat (DSH keeps those records only while it runs).
- **At most two topics work in the background, also when several messages arrive at once.** Three messages sent in the same moment, each about another matter, could all start a topic in the background, one more than the limit. The place is now held before a topic starts.

TheOne only organises: it adds its own entries and views, and never changes your settings or your own chats.

Validation: automated tests (218) and type checks passed; each fix has a test that failed before it. In a fresh DSH with a test model that really edits a file: main chat's changed-files card and its comparison open as before; after restarting DSH, neither main chat nor an ordinary chat shows a card for the earlier turn.

## 中文

- **删除以前的话题后，目录不再一直显示未整理完。** 删除 TheOne 从你以前的会话里找出来的某个话题后，只要那个会话又有了新消息，目录就一直停在「1 个待整理」，依赖目录完整的路由判断也就一直在等。现在删除的话题在会话变长后也算已处理。
- **分支从你选的那条回复开始。** 连续两次发同样的话、再从第二次的回复处分支，分支以前只继承到第一次的回复。现在会继承到你分支的那条回复。
- **TheOne 更新后，改动卡片还在。** TheOne 在 DSH 运行中自我更新后，主聊天里之前回复的「改动」卡片会丢掉文件列表和对比，而普通会话里的卡片还在。现在 TheOne 把每张卡片对应哪个话题的记录存进自己的数据里。DSH 本身重启后，主聊天和普通会话一样，之前的回合都不再显示改动卡片（DSH 只在运行期间保留这些记录）。
- **同时来好几条消息时，后台最多也只有两个话题在跑。** 同一时刻发出三条、各说另一件事的消息，以前可能在后台同时启动三个话题，超过上限。现在启动前先占好名额。

TheOne 只做整理：它只添加自己的入口和视图，不改你的设置，也不改你自己的会话。

已通过自动化测试（218 项）和类型检查；每个修复都有一项修复前会失败的测试。在全新的 DSH 里用一个会真正改文件的测试模型确认：主聊天的改动卡片和对比照常能打开；重启 DSH 后，之前那一轮在主聊天和普通会话里都不显示卡片。
